answer: A mechanism that actually bites: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because vine only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, relic is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any summit approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
